cards.context: The abducens nerve (CN VI) approaches the globe-facing side of lateral rectus. It carries the motor supply that makes the eye turn outward. Its entry point into the muscle is hidden in this view.

reference.title: Cranial Nerves III, IV, and VI: Oculomotor Function

cards.front: The lateral rectus is supplied by which cranial nerve? [___]
cards.context: The lateral rectus is the horizontal muscle that moves the eye away from the nose. Its motor supply is from cranial nerve VI.
